title: UniFi network / VLAN (desired state)
description: A gateway-managed network. NOTE: the API has PUT but no PATCH for networks, and PUT is a full replace requiring management, name, enabled, vlanId, cellularBackupEnabled, internetAccessEnabled, isolationEnabled and ipv4Configuration. A partial body intended to set only the zone will silently drop the DHCP pool, so declare the whole object.

management.description: Discriminator. Networks the gateway routes and serves DHCP for are GATEWAY.

vlanId.description: Must be 1 for the default network. Port profiles and zone policy follow the network, not its subnet, so changing a subnet leaves them alone.

zone.description: Name of the firewall zone this network belongs to. Becomes zoneId. Undocumented-required on create despite being optional in the spec.

isolationEnabled.description: Isolates the network from all others. The controller derives its own 'Isolated Networks' policies from this; declare the cause here and never the derived policies.

mdnsForwardingEnabled.description: Participation in mDNS forwarding. If null the site-level mDNS setting applies.

hostIpAddress.description: The gateway's own address on this network.

pingConflictDetectionEnabled.description: Undocumented-required on create despite being optional in the spec. See go-unifi#195.

_comment.description: Note for a human reader. Keys beginning with an underscore are stripped before anything is sent to or compared against the console.
